query: Has P vs NP been solved?
generated_response: Yes, P vs NP has been solved. The proof was provided by Stephen Cook and Michael Graver in 1975. They showed that the problem of determining whether a problem is solvable in polynomial time is undecidable, meaning there exists a problem for which no algorithm can solve it in polynomial time. This means that problems in P (problems that can be solved in polynomial time) are not complete and do not have efficient solutions.
